checks.name: npm pack allowlist
checks.triage: Package allowlist or tarball drift. Inspect npm pack output and verify package files.

checks.name: adapter template parity
checks.triage: Root adapter copies drifted from .qa-ai/adapters. Edit templates first, then sync root copies.

checks.name: Claude plugin
checks.triage: Generated Claude plugin drifted or plugin structure is invalid. Rebuild/check plugin output.

checks.name: golden target validate-target
checks.triage: Golden target validation failed. Inspect validate-target output and fixture expectations.

checks.name: karate target validate-target
checks.triage: Karate target validation failed. Inspect Karate feature, traceability and target config errors.

checks.name: Karate example (${{ matrix.os }})
checks.triage: Packed Karate example failed. Compare OS-specific runtime output and structural validation errors.

checks.name: Playwright example (${{ matrix.os }})
checks.triage: Packed Playwright example failed. Inspect app startup, Playwright runtime and strict target validation.

checks.name: Maestro + Karate mobile example (${{ matrix.os }})
checks.triage: Mobile structural/runtime check failed. Inspect Maestro validation and Karate API output.

checks.name: Quick path (${{ matrix.os }}, Node ${{ matrix.node }})
checks.triage: Quick path regression. Inspect the intentional failure/correction sequence and target validation.

checks.name: Manual example (${{ matrix.os }}, Node ${{ matrix.node }})
checks.triage: Manual-only packed example failed. Inspect init, generated artifacts and strict validation output.

checks.name: Update migration (${{ matrix.os }}, Node ${{ matrix.node }})
checks.triage: Beta-to-1.0 update migration failed. Inspect preserved paths, legacy config keys and active run state.

checks.name: Clean install (${{ matrix.os }}, Node ${{ matrix.node }})
checks.triage: Packed tarball clean install (E2E-06) failed. Inspect allowlist drift, primary CLI commands and folder-copy fallback.

checks.name: Adversarial failure paths (${{ matrix.os }}, Node ${{ matrix.node }})
checks.triage: E2E-08 adversarial paths failed. Inspect path escape, secret redaction, corrupt state and clean manifest handling.

checks.name: Release dry-run (E2E-09)
checks.triage: E2E-09 release dry-run failed. Inspect dist-tag policy, pack allowlist and post-publish install smoke.

checks.name: Stable config rehearsal (TASK-083)
checks.triage: TASK-083 stable config rehearsal failed. Inspect prepared stable policy, dist-tag latest mapping and pack smoke.

checks.name: Stable Release PR rehearsal (TASK-084)
checks.triage: TASK-084 Release PR rehearsal failed. Inspect review paths, release notes template links and publish workflow readiness.

checks.name: Validate starter
checks.triage: Validate starter failed. Scenario E2E jobs are prerequisites; this job runs validate:core (docs, contracts, validators, smoke), collects coverage data, without re-running E2E.

checks.name: Coverage
checks.triage: Validator/harness coverage dropped below threshold. Validate starter already collected coverage; this job only enforces thresholds from the uploaded artifact.

checks.name: Platform smoke (${{ matrix.os }}, Node ${{ matrix.node }})
checks.triage: Packed npm smoke or CLI integration failed on matrix OS/Node. validate:core runs only in Validate starter.

checks.name: Analyze JavaScript
checks.triage: CodeQL analysis failed or found an alert. Inspect the Security tab and query output.

scheduledChecks.name: RC post-publish (${{ inputs.version }})
scheduledChecks.triage: Live RC post-publish smoke failed. Inspect dist-tag rc, clean install and oldest-supported-beta update path.

scheduledChecks.name: Stable post-publish (${{ inputs.version }})
scheduledChecks.triage: Live stable post-publish smoke failed. Inspect dist-tag latest, pack allowlist, clean install and beta update path.

scheduledChecks.name: Examples (${{ matrix.os }}, Node ${{ matrix.node }}, ${{ inputs.channel || 'rc' }})
scheduledChecks.triage: Scheduled channel compatibility failed. Download compatibility-report.json and compare channel, OS and Node.
